visual.general_description: Color endoscopic montage of twelve luminal mucosal views arranged in a grid of four columns and three rows, forming six side-by-side pairs, each pair headed by a printed case label.
visual.detailed_description: The montage is a 4-column by 3-row grid of circular or rounded endoscopic views; each case occupies two adjacent tiles, with the printed label "case 1" to "case 6" at the top-left corner of the left tile of each pair (cases 1 to 3 in the left half, rows top to bottom; cases 4 to 6 in the right half, rows top to bottom). Case 1: the left tile shows reddened, granular-looking mucosa with scattered pale patches and a dark central lumen; the right tile shows smoother pink-orange mucosa with a lumen at the right edge and a few small white and yellow flecks. Case 2: the left tile shows reddened mucosa with a large irregular whitish patch in the upper centre and folds below; the right tile shows a tubular lumen lined by red mucosa with a fine red mottled pattern and no whitish patch. Case 3: the left tile shows strongly reddened mucosa with bright red streaks and a yellow-green coating around a dark lumen; the right tile shows reddened mucosa with a mottled pale granular pattern and a few small bubbles. Case 4: the left tile shows a lumen with a yellowish-white coating along the upper wall and irregular reddened mucosa; the right tile shows a smooth pink-orange tubular lumen with folds and no yellow coating. Case 5: the left tile shows a large cream-white irregular patch along the wall beside a dark lumen; the right tile shows smooth pink mucosa around a round lumen with a few yellow-green flecks. Case 6: the left tile shows reddened folded mucosa with whitish patches around a dark central lumen; the right tile shows a reddened lumen with folds and a broad pale-white patch in the lower part. No timestamps, device text, arrows, scale bars, graphs or numeric values are visible. The tiles are not labelled before or after; the order within each pair is not printed.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Round endoscopic fields of view showing luminal mucosa in all twelve tiles

evidence.quote: Endoscopic findings were consistent with the respective disease phenotypes.

Endoscopic findings were consistent with the respective disease phenotypes. UC-type cases demonstrated diffuse mucosal friability and ulceration throughout the colon, with MES of 3 and UCEIS scores ranging from 6 to 8. In contrast, CD-like cases exhibited segmental inflammation with skip lesions; deep longitudinal ulcers were observed in Cases 4 and 6, whereas Case 5 showed localized ulcerations confined to the cecum. The SES-CD ranged from 8 to 37 (Table 3). Representative endoscopic images are shown in Figure 1, demonstrating marked mucosal improvement or remission in most patients following treatment.

pixel_observations: Twelve endoscopic tiles in a 4 by 3 grid; six printed labels "case 1" to "case 6" appear on the left tile of each pair.

Left tiles of pairs show reddened mucosa with whitish, cream or yellowish coatings or patches in cases 1 to 6 (case 1 granular reddened mucosa with pale patches; case 2 large whitish patch; case 3 red streaks with yellow-green coating; case 4 yellowish-white coating; case 5 cream-white patch; case 6 whitish patches on folded mucosa).

Right tiles of cases 1, 2, 4 and 5 show smoother pink-orange or pink mucosa with few or no coatings; case 3 right tile shows reddened mottled mucosa; case 6 right tile shows reddened folds with a broad pale-white patch.
No timestamps, device text, arrows, scale bars or numeric values are visible.
The order of the two tiles within each pair is not labelled in the image.

assignments.rationale: Caption and the Figure 1 callout present representative endoscopic images of the six-case series; the image prints one label per case from "case 1" to "case 6", but case labels are not panel letters, so the whole figure is one shared assignment to all six roster patients without assigning individual tiles by appearance.
